info.title: Vomatt REST API
info.description:
REST API of Vomatt, a social polling platform.

**Envelope**: every response is `{ success, data, message, errorCode, error }`. On success `data` holds the payload; on failure `success=false` and `data` is normally null.

**Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <access token>` (JWT). Obtain tokens via `/api/auth/**`; 401 `auth.token.expired` means refresh, `auth.token.invalid` means sign in again.

**Errors**: branch on `errorCode` (lowercase dotted, e.g. `vote.not_found`), never on `message`. Filter-level 401/403/429 use the same body. 429 carries a `Retry-After` header (seconds), except when the rate limiter itself is unavailable.

**Pagination**: list endpoints return `{ items, nextCursor }`; pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor`. `limit` defaults to 20 and is clamped to 1..50.

**i18n**: send `Accept-Language` (`zh-TW` default, `en`) to localize `message`.

Conventions, flows and glossary: `docs/frontend/README.md` in the repository.

**Precondition**: none; Scheduled, Open and Ended Polls are all readable
**Behavior**: returns the Poll. `options[].votes` is null (Sealed) for everyone, owner included, until the Poll has Ended; `participantCount` (Turnout) is always present, and so is `inviteeCount` for an INVITE_ONLY Poll.

put.description:
**Auth**: required (owner only)
**Precondition**: the Poll is Scheduled (its start time has not arrived)
**Behavior**: replaces title, description, times, Voter Visibility, Audience, Invitees, tags and options with the body (same body and validation as create). An omitted `startTime`, `voterVisibility`, `audience`, `inviteeIds` or `inviteeEmails` keeps the current value; the Poll does not open on edit. Audience can change only here, so it is fixed once the Poll is Open. `groupIds` expands the caller's Groups now: their members are merged into `inviteeIds` / `inviteeEmails` when that list is set, so an explicit `[]` plus `groupIds` replaces that kind of Invitee with the Groups' members (already-invited members are kept as they are); a null list keeps that kind of Invitee and adds the Groups' members on top.
**Side effects**: all options are replaced, so option IDs change; tag usage counts are adjusted for added / removed tags and for an Audience change (only PUBLIC Polls are counted). `inviteeIds` replaces the Invitees added by ID and `inviteeEmails` those added by email (matched by address); an Audience other than INVITE_ONLY removes them all. Each new Invitee tied to a user gets an unread Invitation notification, including one removed and invited again; each newly added email Invitee is sent an invitation email (at most once per address per Poll, even after removing and re-adding it, and at most `EMAIL_INVITATION_DAILY_LIMIT` (default 200) per owner per day; over the limit the Invitee is still added and only the email is skipped).
**Errors**:
- 403 `vote.forbidden`: the caller is not the owner
- 404 `vote.not_found`: Poll does not exist, is Deleted, or is INVITE_ONLY and the caller is neither its owner nor an Invitee
- 400 `vote.not_editable`: the Poll is Open or Ended
- 400 `vote.invitee.not_invite_only`: `inviteeIds`, `inviteeEmails` or `groupIds` is not empty but the resulting Audience is not INVITE_ONLY
- 400 `vote.invitee.ids_invalid`: one of `inviteeIds` is not an existing user or is suspended (`inviteeEmails` and `groupIds` never cause it)
- 400 `vote.multiple.not_allowed`: `allowMultipleChoices` is true
- 400 `vote.options.min`: fewer than 2 options
- 400 `vote.options.max`: more than 10 options
- 400 `vote.end_time.past`: `endTime` is in the past
- 400 `vote.end_time.before_start`: `endTime` is not after `startTime`
- 400 `vote.duration.exceeded`: `endTime` is more than 365 days after the start time
- 400 `tag.ids.invalid`: one of `tagIds` does not exist
- 400 `common.validation_failed`: a field breaks its size / required rule (first failing field only)
- 404 `group.not_found`: one of `groupIds` does not exist or belongs to someone else
- 409 `common.conflict`: the Poll stayed busy with other changes for 3 seconds; nothing was changed, try again

delete.description:
**Auth**: required (owner only)
**Precondition**: the Poll is Scheduled, or is still within the delete window after posting (default 20 minutes, configurable; any state, even with Ballots); `deletable` on the Poll response tells the owner whether this still holds
**Behavior**: soft-deletes the Poll. From then on it is gone for everyone, owner included: every Poll endpoint (including Comments, Replies, likes and notification read) returns 404 `vote.not_found`, and it leaves Feed / Explore / Search, profile lists, My Polls, Ended Notifications and popular tag counts. The data is kept.
**Side effects**: nobody is notified
**Errors**:
- 400 `vote.delete.window_passed`: the Poll is Open or Ended and the delete window (default 20 minutes, configurable) has passed
- 403 `vote.forbidden`: the caller is not the owner
- 404 `vote.not_found`: Poll does not exist or is already Deleted
- 409 `common.conflict`: the Poll stayed busy with other changes for 3 seconds; nothing was changed, try again

**Side effects**: the Comment can no longer be edited or liked. Responds with an empty success body (`{ "success": true }`)

get.description:
**Auth**: public (optional login changes response: `myOptionId` of each item is filled for the caller's Ballots)
**Precondition**: none
**Behavior**: cursor-paged list of Open or Ended PUBLIC Polls; Scheduled, UNLISTED and INVITE_ONLY Polls never appear.
- `status=open` (default) + `sort=newest` (default): most recently opened first (the Feed)
- `status=open` + `sort=closing`: closing soonest first
- `status=open` + `sort=top`: highest Turnout (`participantCount`) first, ties most recently opened first (Top); Turnout can change between pages, so dedupe items by `id`
- `status=ended`: most recently ended first; `sort` must be omitted
- `tag`: only Polls under that tag slug (Explore); `q`: free-text match on title and description, option text is not matched (Search), at least 2 characters
- Filters combine. `nextCursor` null means the last page; pass it back unchanged as `cursor`. `limit` is clamped to 1-50 (default 20).
**Side effects**: none
**Errors**:
- 400 `common.invalid_status`: `status` is neither `open` nor `ended`
- 400 `common.invalid_sort`: `sort` is not `newest`, `closing` or `top`
- 400 `vote.list.sort_not_allowed`: `sort` was sent together with `status=ended`
- 400 `vote.search.query_too_short`: `q` is shorter than 2 characters
- 400 `common.cursor_invalid`: `cursor` is malformed or was issued by another list or another ordering of this list

post.description:
**Auth**: required
**Precondition**: none
**Behavior**: creates a Poll owned by the caller. With no `startTime` (or a past one) the Poll is Open immediately; a future `startTime` makes it Scheduled until that time. `voterVisibility` defaults to OWNER; `audience` defaults to PUBLIC. An UNLISTED Poll is reachable only through its link: it stays out of Feed / Explore / Search and the owner's profile, and is listed only in My Polls. An INVITE_ONLY Poll is reachable only by its owner and its Invitees: the users in `inviteeIds` and the addresses in `inviteeEmails` (duplicates and the owner's own ID / address are ignored; more can be added later); everyone else gets 404 `vote.not_found`. An address is always listed as entered, whether or not it belongs to an account; an active account's user gets access right away, any other address once someone verifies it at sign-up / sign-in. `groupIds` invites the current members of the caller's Groups: members added by ID join `inviteeIds` (suspended ones are skipped) and members added by email join `inviteeEmails` by their stored address; later Group changes never touch the Poll.
**Side effects**: usage count of each attached tag +1 for a PUBLIC Poll (UNLISTED and INVITE_ONLY Polls are not counted); each Invitee tied to a user gets an unread Invitation notification (unread count, `unread` on My Polls `status=open`); each new email Invitee is sent an invitation email linking to the Poll (only when email is enabled) (at most once per address per Poll, even after removing and re-adding it, and at most `EMAIL_INVITATION_DAILY_LIMIT` (default 200) per owner per day; over the limit the Invitee is still added and only the email is skipped) and gets the Invitation notification once tied to a user; the creation is audit-logged.
**Errors**:
        - 400 `vote.invitee.not_invite_only`: `inviteeIds`, `inviteeEmails` or `groupIds` is not empty but `audience` is not INVITE_ONLY
        - 400 `vote.invitee.ids_invalid`: one of `inviteeIds` is not an existing user or is suspended (`inviteeEmails` and `groupIds` never cause it)
        - 400 `vote.multiple.not_allowed`: `allowMultipleChoices` is true
        - 400 `vote.options.min`: fewer than 2 options
        - 400 `vote.options.max`: more than 10 options
        - 400 `vote.end_time.past`: `endTime` is in the past
        - 400 `vote.end_time.before_start`: `endTime` is not after `startTime`
        - 400 `vote.duration.exceeded`: `endTime` is more than 365 days after the start time
        - 400 `tag.ids.invalid`: one of `tagIds` does not exist
        - 400 `common.validation_failed`: a field breaks its size / required rule (first failing field only)
- 404 `user.not_found`: the signed-in user no longer exists
- 404 `group.not_found`: one of `groupIds` does not exist or belongs to someone else

post.description:
**Auth**: required
**Precondition**: the Poll is Open (not Scheduled, not Ended)
**Behavior**: records the caller's Ballot with exactly one Selection. If the caller already holds a Ballot it is replaced by the new one (change of mind); casting the same option again only updates `anonymous`. `anonymous: true` makes it an Anonymous Ballot, left out of `GET /api/votes/{voteId}/voters` whatever the Poll's Voter Visibility; an omitted or `null` `anonymous` keeps the current Ballot's flag, and a first Ballot uses the caller's `anonymousBallotByDefault` (false until set). The response is the Poll with the results still Sealed and `myOptionId` set.
**Side effects**: Turnout +1 on the first Ballot only; the option counts move silently (not visible until the Poll has Ended); the action is audit-logged. When this Ballot leaves every Invitee of an INVITE_ONLY Poll holding a Ballot (the owner's own Ballot never counts), the Poll Ends now (`endTime` moves, `deadline` stays), so the response comes back Ended with results visible and the Ended Notification follows.
**Errors**:
- 404 `vote.not_found`: Poll does not exist, is Deleted, or is INVITE_ONLY and the caller is neither its owner nor an Invitee
- 400 `vote.ended`: the Poll has Ended; Ballots are frozen
- 400 `vote.not_allowed`: the Poll is still Scheduled
- 400 `vote.multiple.not_allowed`: `optionIds` holds more than one ID
- 404 `vote.option.not_found`: the option ID does not exist
- 400 `vote.option.not_in_vote`: the option belongs to another Poll
- 404 `user.not_found`: the signed-in user no longer exists
- 400 `common.validation_failed`: `optionIds` is empty
- 429 `common.rate_limited`: more than 30 Ballot writes (cast, Retract, remove Selection) by the caller within 60 seconds; no `Retry-After`
- 409 `common.conflict`: the Poll stayed busy with other changes for 3 seconds; nothing was recorded, try again

**Auth**: required (owner only)
**Precondition**: the Poll is INVITE_ONLY and Scheduled or Open, and the Invitee holds no Ballot
**Behavior**: removes the Invitee added by this address (normalized like sign-in does: lower-cased, trimmed, Gmail in canonical form), whether or not it belongs to an account; from then on the Poll is 404 `vote.not_found` for that person and verifying the address no longer grants access. When every remaining Invitee of an Open Poll holds a Ballot (and at least one remains), the Poll Ends now (`endTime` moves, `deadline` stays) and the Ended Notification follows. This check also runs when nothing was removed, so even a no-op call can end such a Poll.
**Errors**:

- 400 `vote.invitee.not_invite_only`: the Poll is not INVITE_ONLY
